Intro: I spoke with the widow. She was close to utter madness, obsessed with freedom. But she is not alone, we can help her. I thank you for calling upon me.
We have done all that we could. Now…no more distractions, no more worries. Today is the day, dear rival. The day our feud will settle.
My fifty-fourth dish, Le Rat Bourguignon, is completed. Now we can finally compete to see who really is the best chef of Verehn.
Let us begin, dearest rival! Prepare your best!
Success: This…you truly are the greatest chef I have ever seen. It is no longer right to call you my rival. Instead, can I call you my friend?
Fail: It seems our feud has ended in my victory. Thank you for being my rival. You helped me reach new heights as a chef. Till we meet again, dear friend.
Reject: ...you…but why? Did our…did our feud mean anything to you!? I saw you as a friend, yet you treat me like a vermin!?
